segments.t: On macOS, use KTPH002KTPH000KTPH003 where KTPH004KTPH001KTPH005 is shown.
Find in the active tab (in a focused terminal on Windows and Linux the key goes to the shell, see KTPH000TerminalKTPH001)
Start / stop the session journal of the active tab
Add a screenshot to the running session journal
Show/hide the live journal panel on its last-used side
Show/hide the Coding Agents panel on its last-used side
Jump to the next coding agent waiting for a decision, across windows
Dock the file browser on the left
Dock the file browser on the right
Zoom the terminal font in/out (Cmd + wheel on macOS)
Close a local cmd.exe/PowerShell tab (EOF for bash-family shells and SSH)

The zoom keys (KTPH008KTPH000KTPH009 or KTPH010KTPH001KTPH011 with KTPH012KTPH002KTPH013 / KTPH014KTPH003KTPH015 / KTPH016KTPH004KTPH017; KTPH018KTPH005KTPH019 on macOS) zoom the terminal only while a terminal tab is selected. In a snippet editor or file editor tab they reach the editor, and KTPH020KTPH006KTPH021+KTPH022KTPH007KTPH023 types its character there.
These keys work while a terminal pane has the focus. For how they behave with several panes, see KTPH000Broadcast modeKTPH001.
Copy the terminal selection / paste into the terminal (Windows and Linux; KTPH004KTPH000KTPH005+KTPH006KTPH001KTPH007 / KTPH008KTPH002KTPH009+KTPH010KTPH003KTPH011 on macOS)
Sent to the shell: redraws or clears the screen in bash, psql or a REPL, and the scrollback is kept
Sent to the shell: moves the cursor one character forward at a bash prompt and pages forward in KTPH000 or KTPH001
Clear Buffer: empty the terminal screen and its scrollback
Back-tab (KTPH000), for example to go back one field or panel in a full-screen program
Move one word left / right in the shell (Windows and Linux)
Move one word left / right on macOS (sends KTPH000 / KTPH001, as Terminal.app does)
Scroll korTTY's scrollback by a page; inside a full-screen program such as KTPH000, KTPH001 or KTPH002 the key goes to the program

Scroll korTTY's scrollback by a line (KTPH004KTPH000KTPH005+KTPH006KTPH001KTPH007 / KTPH008KTPH002KTPH009+KTPH010KTPH003KTPH011 on macOS); on Windows and Linux the keys go to a full-screen program instead while one runs
Next / previous tab, also while the terminal has the focus (the KTPH001KTPH000KTPH002 key on macOS too)

On Windows and Linux, KTPH010Clear BufferKTPH011 and KTPH012FindKTPH013 have no key of their own, so KTPH014KTPH000KTPH015+KTPH016KTPH001KTPH017 and KTPH018KTPH002KTPH019+KTPH020KTPH003KTPH021 stay with the programs running in the terminal. Use right-click → KTPH022Clear BufferKTPH023 or KTPH024FindKTPH025 in the terminal, or KTPH026Edit → Find…KTPH027 with the mouse. KTPH028KTPH004KTPH029+KTPH030KTPH005KTPH031+KTPH032KTPH006KTPH033 stays Terminal-only Fullscreen and KTPH034KTPH007KTPH035+KTPH036KTPH008KTPH037+KTPH038KTPH009KTPH039 still docks the file browser on the left.

Every other combination of KTPH022KTPH006KTPH023, KTPH024KTPH007KTPH025 and KTPH026KTPH008KTPH027 with the arrow keys, KTPH028KTPH009KTPH029 / KTPH030KTPH010KTPH031, KTPH032KTPH011KTPH033 / KTPH034KTPH012KTPH035, KTPH036KTPH013KTPH037 / KTPH038KTPH014KTPH039 and KTPH040KTPH015KTPH041 to KTPH042KTPH016KTPH043 is sent the way xterm sends it (KTPH044KTPH017KTPH045 always toggles fullscreen), for example KTPH046KTPH018KTPH047+KTPH048KTPH019KTPH049 as KTPH000 and KTPH050KTPH020KTPH051+KTPH052KTPH021KTPH053 as KTPH001. The arrow keys follow the program's cursor-key mode: KTPH002 and KTPH003 switch it on and then receive KTPH004, while a shell receives KTPH005. Connections with a non-xterm terminal emulation (Wyse, TeleVideo, HP, SCO ANSI, IBM 3270/5250, PETSCII) keep sending fixed sequences without modifiers.
These keys work in the local and the remote list of an SFTP Manager tab; see KTPH000KeysKTPH001.
These keys work in the Snippet Manager (library and editor tabs); see KTPH000Opening the Snippet ManagerKTPH001.
Open the Snippet Manager, or focus its search field when it is already open
Browse: show the selected snippet in the read-only preview tab
Open the selected snippet in an editor tab
Open the previewed snippet in an editor tab; the typed character is kept
Save the active editor tab (also in a standalone snippet editor window)
Close the active editor tab (asks about unsaved changes)
Hide or show the library, giving the editor tabs the full width
Quick open: find a snippet by part of its name or a tag and open it in an editor tab (KTPH004KTPH000KTPH005 / KTPH006KTPH001KTPH007 choose, KTPH008KTPH002KTPH009 opens, KTPH010KTPH003KTPH011 closes)
Clear the search; KTPH001KTPH000KTPH002 never closes the Snippet Manager
Move to the snippet list (selects the first snippet when none is selected)

If the focus is on the Snippet Manager's own tab header in the main window (tab mode), KTPH004KTPH000KTPH005+KTPH006KTPH001KTPH007 still saves the project, and KTPH008KTPH002KTPH009+KTPH010KTPH003KTPH011 closes the Snippet Manager tab after asking about unsaved changes.
These keys work inside the snippet editor's code field; see KTPH000AI Code completionsKTPH001.
KTPH002KTPH000KTPH003+KTPH004KTPH001KTPH005 (cursor at the end of a line with text)
Open the completion list (the combination is configurable, see KTPH000Snippet Editor settingsKTPH001)

Open the completion list anywhere (on macOS the physical KTPH008KTPH000KTPH009 key, not KTPH010KTPH001KTPH011; KTPH012KTPH002KTPH013+KTPH014KTPH003KTPH015 and KTPH016KTPH004KTPH017+KTPH018KTPH005KTPH019 work there too, because macOS often reserves KTPH020KTPH006KTPH021+KTPH022KTPH007KTPH023 for switching input sources)
Move the selection; typing filters the list
Close the list, or dismiss ghost text

Stop the running AI request of this editor — an AI Code action, the Full code analysis or its apply, a diagram; works in the whole editor and its analysis panel, never closes the editor (see KTPH000Stopping and retrying AI requestsKTPH001)
KTPH001KTPH000KTPH002 (New analysis area of the analysis panel)
Start the Full code analysis with the chosen AI profile (see KTPH000Choosing the AI profile before the analysis startsKTPH001)
Next / previous ghost-text candidate (physical KTPH000 and KTPH001 keys of a US layout)
KTPH002KTPH000KTPH003+KTPH004KTPH001KTPH005 (anywhere else, or when another combination is configured)
KTPH001Accept KTPH007 applyKTPH002 the reviewed AI change (see KTPH003Reviewing an AI changeKTPH004); KTPH005KTPH000KTPH006 does nothing there
These keys work in the zoom window of the Full code analysis flow diagram; see KTPH000Full code analysisKTPH001.
Fit the diagram into the window
Show agent command variants (KTPH000, KTPH001, KTPH002)
Cancel the selected agent run's tab
Toggle thinking details for the selected run
Pause the selected run at a safe checkpoint
